messages:
Noah: Friday night QB pool update: I promised to throw $10 into the office pool if my QB throws 3 TDs. placing bets and feelings. :money_with_wings:
Priya: Which QB? you mean the literal QB or the fantasy QB? rules are ambiguous and that's by design. :laughing:
Eli: You said literal QB last week and choked. remember the Hail Mary incident. :football:
Noah: It's literal. Baker-ish decision pending. also side note: I'll take wagers on which teammate brings donuts Monday if I lose.
Maya: deal. I pick donuts and moral support. also, quick trade question: is it insane to offer my RB+2nd for Priya's QB if she also throws in a streamer?
Priya: depends on the RB. send names.
Noah: For context, my Friday lineup pre-game:
```
QB: Tua
RB: Cook
WR: Metcalf
WR: D. Smith
Flex: bench-warrior
BN: deep-bench
```
Eli: Tua late-night vibes, risky but high ceiling.
coach-bot: "coach-bot: Reminder: office QB pool picks lock at 6:45pm PT. Current entries: 9. Pot: $90."
Faye: Question: can we add a running tiebreaker like "who eats the most donuts" if points tie? low stakes high drama.
Maya: absolutely, bring a receipt.
Priya: @Eli curious about that trade. I'll give up my QB if you add Franklin (bench) + 3rd.
Eli: hmmm I'll think. I really want to keep my depth for the playoffs.
Noah: Poll: who wins the weekend upset? React: 🟢 The Underdog / 🟡 Chalk / 🔴 My Money on Chaos
Faye: 🟢 Underdog, always.
Priya: 🟡 Chalk. safe picks.
Eli: 🔴 Chaos. spice it up.
Noah: coach-bot: "coach-bot: Pick locked: Noah chose QB Tua at 6:44:12pm PT. Good luck!"
Maya: also, tiny logistics: can we cap side bets at $20? my wallet disagrees with the current vibe.
Priya: yes please cap. also I will accept donuts as payment.
Faye: GIF: tiny marching band celebrating (link)
Eli: End thread: can someone remind me to actually set my Monday lineup? I have a history of optimism and then forgetting. DM for trade talk.
